LegacyTrackerDoc.title: Legacy Tracker Document
LegacyTrackerDoc.description: Backward-compatible WOOPP v1 production tracker document stored at users/{userId}/tracker/main.

ProductionWorkspace.title: WOOPP Production Workspace V5
ProductionWorkspace.description: Multi-project 3D print production management workspace document stored at users/{userId}/tracker/v5_workspace without overwriting users/{userId}/tracker/main.

migratedFromV1.description: Whether existing v1 data from tracker/main was migrated into this workspace

colors.description: Global color catalog available across projects

machines.description: Printer fleet records with status, speedFactor, setupBufferMinutes, maintenanceUntilMs, and active assignment

projects.description: Multi-project definitions with sales channel, priority, deadline, targets, derived carry-forward maps, planningSessions lineage, and allocations

jobs.description: All production print plate jobs across projects including immutable Product Studio catalogItems snapshots, Kanban stage, archive/cancellation audit fields, and server timestamps

presets.description: Saved reusable alphabet A-Z quantity presets

inventory.description: Physical produced stock, project reservations, wastage, and ledger movements

log.description: Chronological audit trail of production, machine, scheduling, queue lifecycle, and inventory events

settings.description: Workspace preferences including default plate capacity, turnaroundBufferMinutes, timezone, theme, and optional adminEmails allowlist

serverUpdatedAt.description: Authoritative Firebase serverTimestamp() recorded on cloud writes

ProductCategory.title: Product Studio Category
ProductCategory.description: Custom e-commerce product category stored at users/{userId}/catalogCategories/{categoryId}.

imageUrl.description: Optional external HTTPS cover image URL (or null)

CatalogProduct.title: Product Studio Catalog Product
CatalogProduct.description: E-commerce product definition with read-only auto SKU, HTTPS image URLs, MYR price, and optional variations stored at users/{userId}/catalogProducts/{productId}.

priceMyr.description: Optional selling price in MYR (or null)

images.description: Ordered external HTTPS image URLs (max 12, no base64)

options.description: Optional variation option definitions (max 4; each option validates id, name, int sortOrder, and 1–60 string values of 1–80 chars, supporting alphabet A–Z and custom lists)

variants.description: Product variations (up to 12 embedded directly on parent document; products with >12 variants persist to users/{userId}/catalogProducts/{productId}/variants/{variantId} subcollection to stay within Firestore 1,000-expression ceiling)

CatalogSkuReservation.title: Product Studio SKU Reservation
CatalogSkuReservation.description: Atomic uniqueness lock for auto-generated WOOPP SKUs stored at users/{userId}/catalogSkus/{sku}.

productId.description: ID of the product owning this SKU

CategoryPlateSetting.title: Category Production Plate Rule
CategoryPlateSetting.description: Planner-owned plate capacity or manual plate composition rule per category stored at users/{userId}/catalogPlateSettings/{categoryId}.

allocationMode.description: Category plate allocation mode inside Auto Plate Planner

plateCapacity.description: Configured category units per plate (1–5000) or null

defaultEstimatedMinutes.description: Default Bambu Studio estimated duration per plate in minutes (1–4320)

/users/{userId}/tracker/main.description: Preserved original v1 production tracker document (read-only during v5 migration, untouched).

/users/{userId}/tracker/v5_workspace.description: WOOPP 5.0/6.0 multi-project production management and Smart ETA Scheduling state isolated per authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/catalogCategories/{categ.description: Product Studio custom product categories isolated per authenticated owner.

/users/{userId}/catalogProducts/{product.description: Product Studio e-commerce catalog products isolated per authenticated owner.

/users/{userId}/catalogSkus/{sku}.description: Atomic uniqueness registry for auto-generated WOOPP-XXXXXXXX SKUs.

/users/{userId}/catalogPlateSettings/{ca.description: Auto Plate Planner capacity and manual plate composition settings per Product Studio category.
